== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-r5d4-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[R5-D4 (Arfive-Defour)]] (Decipher; Decipher's [[R5-D4 (Arfive-Defour) (Decipher Errata 1998)|November 1998 errata]] was published as text only): The game text changes: “If on a” becomes “During your control phase, if aboard your”; “hit” becomes “damaged”; “Ion Cannon,” becomes “ion cannon,”; “hyperspeed during your next control phase.” becomes “hyperspeed.”. These are the same words as [[R5-D4 (Arfive-Defour) (Decipher Errata 1998)|Decipher's errata]]. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “R5-D4 (Arfive-Defour)” and no “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
